name: Yasser Kobeissi

hero.sub: Twenty years across broadcast, events, 3D and motion. Based in Riyadh, from Beirut.

statement: He arrives with a marker and leaves with a room. In between: a white model, a render, forty people on site, and a client who finally sees it.

portrait.label: I · The director
copy: Yasser Kobeissi grew up in Beirut and spent ten years inside live television, running graphics for four channels at once. Speed, precision and a deadline that does not move.

He moved to Riyadh for the opportunity and stayed for the scale: national days, Ramadan nights, forums, trophies and the stands that people walk into rather than past. He leads the creative department at Sovyal Events.
He draws first, always. He is the loud one in the room. The work is the quiet one.
